listing.summary: Adds a variety of weird ships, new quests and now even an industry!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a large series of unique kitbash ships for every faction, along with bounties, quests, campaign content, and player faction flags.

description:
Download
v5.2.2

Dependent on Magiclib

Thanks to some fancy trickery (RetroGen™) the new starsystems from this mod will retroactively generate into

saves created without them, making it theoretically safe to add midsave!

A series of hopefully unique and interesting ships. My eventual goal was to kitbash a ship for every faction as an exercise for myself, now that that has been accomplished, the new direction for this mod is mostly bounties, quests and campaign level content.

Also adds a series of player faction flags based off the old designs, intended to allow for roleplaying as a sub-faction of the major vanilla factions, these flags have been used to delineate factions in the ship showcase.

Its called JaydeePiracy because the first kitbash was a pirate ship (its actually no longer implemented in the mod, search the files for the Tortuga if you dare) and the mod was originally created to share that one ship, If you would rather call it JaydeePack, be my guest, but its too annoying to change the name on the back-end for me to bother with something so immaterial.

Combat Layer Content

Spoiler
Show me the ships! (In more detail)
Spoiler
Pirates
(Pirates) Plunder: Created by pirates, beloved by mercenaries, a compact dedicated Missile Destroyer refit of the Sunder brought to you by the Thulian Raiders.


(Pirates) Phaeton Mk.II: A misguided refit of the Phaeton, this deathwagon utilises an excess of low grade fusion fuel to leave streaks of antimatter fire across the void.


BOUNTY (Pirates) Falcon (VI-P): A pirate retrofit of a Falcon (VI), left behind by the Domain Sixth Battlegroup post collapse. Extremely well suited to missile bombardment, and perhaps the inspiration for the regular Falcon (P).



Mercenaries
(Mercenaries) Epistle: An advanced command shuttle refit of the Kite, perfect for a fleet Admiral who values their own life enough to lead from the rear.

(Mercenaries) Cinquedea: Capable long range strike vessel, often used for chasing fleeing bounties, developed just between the end of the "Cruiser School" revolution and the new High Tech dominated era of Domain Procurement.

(Mercenaries) Conduit: An innovative but maligned 'Pocket Astral' built around a novel throughdeck hangar. Designed and then abandoned by the Tri-Tachyon corporation, the Conduit is now mostly used by Mercenaries and the military contractors employed by the Independents.

Independents
(Independents) Gretchen: Pushed into service by desperate Polities, one of the first Phase ships ever deployed, dating back to the start of the Cruiser School revolution. 


(Independents) Lupara: A falcon modified for civilian mining operations, packs a serious missile armament, at the cost of a hacked fabricator that cannot produce sophisticated guidance systems.


(Independents) Florencia: An adequately equipped policing vessel, designed deliberately to have shared parts with civilian vessels available on the fringe.


(Independents) Cydonia: An extensively equipped deep-space exploration platform, the Cydonia is even rarer and more desirable than its cousin the Apogee.


(Independents) Vertex (Wing): A retrofitted survey drone deployed by the Cydonia, equipped for point-defence and utilises deliberately overloaded equipment to produce a small arc field. Barely suited for combat.



Persean League
(Persean League) Hummingbird: Centred around entropy amplification technology acquired through corporate espionage, this rare frigate is a capable support craft.


(Persean League) Shoebill: A logistics minelayer hybrid, deployed on the outskirts of Domain space to support the few manned fleets sent to crush insurrection on the frontiers.


BOUNTY (Persean League) Eider: An ill-fated vessel, the Eider was designed as a manoeuvrable anvil from which carriers could strike behind, a paradoxical anchor for the "cruiser school" doctrine.


(Persean League) Trident (DEM) (Wing): A formidable refit of the Trident Bomber to fit within Persean League doctrine, trading half its wing size for an armament of advanced Dragonfire and Gazer DEMs.



Hegemony
(Hegemony) Arcubus: A conservative artillery battleship deployed simultaneously with the Legion, particularly favoured by the XIV, only the modified variant remains in the Persean Sector. 


(Hegemony) Florencia (A): A variant of the Florencia up-armoured for use by the Hegemony Auxiliary, often used for policing action and anti-piracy.



Sindrian Diktat
(Sindrian Diktat) Supremator: Brainchild of Andrada's inflated ego after the "success" of the Executor, an extensive refit of the Conquest to bring a full battery of firepower to bear.


(Sindrian Diktat) Drover (LG): Gunship conversion of the Drover developed by the Lions Guard to crush the individualism often displayed by "fighter jocks" who detract from military unity and togetherness, spitting in the face of Andradanism.   



Tri-Tachyon
(Tri-tachyon) Miridian: Military recreation of the Apogee, the development of which was funded by a nostalgic board member.


BOUNTY (Tri-tachyon) Thunderer: A "revolutionary" new type of warship, a Capital class vessel designed for anti-piracy and specialised against smallcraft, manoeuvrable and well armed, but often finds itself outmatched by its own weight class.


(Tri-tachyon) Pup (Wing): A large internal parasite craft deployed by the Thunderer, less a fighter and more a concealable escort.



Luddic Church
(Luddic Church) Cassius: Radical restructuring of the Legion, commissioned after the Hegemony and Church of Galactic Redemption's falling out after the first AI war.


(Luddic Church) Lorica: Sidegrade to the Manticore deemed unnecessary by the Hegemony, immensely durable for its size but lightly armed. Donated to the Church during the first AI war and never requested back.



Luddic Path
(Luddic Path) Atlas Mk.II-LP: Atlas repurposed by Luddic Fanatics into a bombardment vessel, provides unconventional fire support with its built in unique weapon, the Cargo IED Launcher.


(Luddic Path) Grendel (LP): The demons of Moloch were driven to madness when forced to crew this vessel, for it had already been claimed by the light of Ludd himself as a vehicle of Holy War and belonged to the righteous, or so the story goes.


Show me the [REDACTED]
Spoiler

Explorarium
(Explorarium) Custodian: An aberrant drone, its self-repair programs corrupted by a new prime directive. Provides fighter support to automated defence fleets.


(Explorarium) Keep (Wing): A large internal parasite craft deployed by the Custodian, provides heavy fire support in a durable and compact package.


(Explorarium) Barbican (Wing): A drone wing deployed by the Custodian, supports the sluggish Automated fleet by killing enemy engines with an armament of salamander missiles.



Remnant
(Remnants) Iota: Bleeding edge ultraheavy gunship, the largest ship to ever be equipped with the proprietary Tri-tachyon phase teleporter.


Data Expunged by Tri-Tachyon Consumer Loyalty Division
Spoiler


Find logs detailing an advanced Hybrid Droneship at the Alpha Site
Okay, but show me though.
Spoiler
BOUNTY (Alpha Site) Chuuni: An advanced Hybrid Droneship, intended to be crewed by an AI Core and human crew in tandem.


[SUPER ALABASTER] Clearance Required
Spoiler


Defeat the defenders of a Coronal Hypershunt to receive a garbled transmission

Okay, but show me though.
Spoiler
BOUNTY (Omega) Penrose: An impossible designation for an impossible craft, a ludicrous modular *game* deployed to test notable *campers* proficiency at *dancing*.

*Sprite remastered at the request of and with the permission of Mae1strom
Anomalous Abyssal Hyperspace Readings Detected
Spoiler


Investigate a rogue star in the Abyss above the core-worlds
Okay, but what's there though?
Spoiler
(Unknown) Laplacian: A vessel lost in time, its hull warped and transmuted by the radiation from a strange star.

Campaign Layer Content

Spoiler
The Lobster Heist
Spoiler
Steal the secrets of Lobster Breeding from Volturn!


The Hubris of Man
Spoiler
